statusCode.description_en:
If the request to the target site succeeds, the HTTP status code of the target URL is returned.

If the request to the target site fails, a custom error code is returned:

    2.1 4030: The target site has security restrictions, such as robots.txt or security policies.
    
    2.2 4080: The request timed out.
    
    2.3 4290: The rate limiting policy of the site was triggered.
    
    2.4 5010: An unknown exception occurred
statusCode.description_zh:
若目标站点请求成功，返回目标 url 的 HttpCode。

若目标站点请求失败，返回 IQS 定制错误码：

    2.1 4030：目标站点安全限制（robots.txt、安全策略等）
    
    2.2 4080：请求超时
    
    2.3 4290：触发站点限流策略
    
    2.4 5010：未知异常

description_en:
Reads HTML and parses web page content through a browser sandbox environment.
The operation begins parsing after the target page resources are fully loaded (you can adjust the maximum wait time through the pageTimeout parameter). The overall response time is significantly affected by the resource loading status of the target site
description_zh:
通过浏览器沙箱环境读取 HTML 并解析网页内容。
接口将在目标页面资源完全加载后开始解析（可通过 pageTimeout 参数调整最大等待时长），接口整体耗时将显著受目标站点资源加载情况的影响
kebab_example: aliyun iqs read-page-scrape --url https://www.example.com --timeout 60000 --page-timeout 15000 --location example-string --max-age 1296000 --readability '{"excludeAllLinks":false,"readabilityMode":"none","excludedTags":["form"],"excludeAllImages":false}' --formats html --api-version 2024-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReadPageScrape

parameters.help_en:
The format of the parsing result.

rawHtml: the HTML of the target site.
html: the page content processed based on readabilityMode.
markdown: the Markdown content converted from the HTML.
text: the text content extracted from the HTML.
screenshot: a screenshot of the target site
parameters.help_zh:
解析结果格式

rawHtml：目标站点的 html
html: 根据 readabilityMode 处理后的页面内容
markdown：根据 html 转换成的 markdown 内容
text：html 中的文本内容
screenshot: 目标站点截图
parameters.name: formats

parameters.help_en: This parameter does not need to be specified
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en:
The maximum cache validity period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1296000.
If the cache duration is less than the value of maxAge, cached content is returned.
If maxAge is set to 0, caching is not used
parameters.help_zh:
最大缓存时间，单位（秒），默认值：1296000。
若缓存时间小于 maxAge，则返回缓存内容；
若 maxAge 等于 0，则不使用缓存
parameters.name: max_age

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for waiting for the target site resources to fully load. The value of pageTimeout must be less than the value of timeout.

Default value: 15000
parameters.help_zh:
等待目标站点资源完全加载的超时时间，pageTimeout 应小于 timeout 时长

默认值：15000
parameters.name: page_timeout
